blind.description: A leaning stack of four medieval round wooden shields. Each shield features a dark iron rim studded with rivets, a rounded central metal boss, and painted planked wooden faces in alternating patterns (red and yellow quarters, green and yellow quarters). The shields lean closely against one another in a tidy row. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and stylized with clean hand-painted textures, with no broken polygons, floating parts, or fused artifacts.
blind.from_above: Shows four parallel curved shield rims lined up horizontally, looking like a ribbed or slotted structure with alternating colored shield backs and fronts visible between the rims.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 feet tall (roughly up to the knee/lower-thigh of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 to 3 feet in length across the stack.
